sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:66705
Court No. - 73
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12195 of 2024

Applicant :- Aamir
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Rahul Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Rahul Singh Rajpoot, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Rajeev Dhar Dwivedi,
learned Aga for the State.

2.  The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 421 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 307, 324 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Maudaha, District Hamirpur during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged on 12.10.2023 against applicant and his family members and according to the FIR marriage of the applicant was performed with the informant and after marriage applicant and his family members tortured her and on 07.09.2023 on the instigation of his family members, applicant inflicted knife injury on the abdomen of the informant and due to the injury caused by the applicant, she sustained serious injuries and she had to admit in the hospital.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that on the basis of false allegation only due to matrimonial dispute applicant being husband of the informant has been made accused in the Aamir vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157716058/
1 present matter.
5.

entities.text: Aamir vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that in the FIR along with applicant his entire family members were also roped and this fact clearly suggests that FIR of the present case is based on false facts.
6. He further submits that however as per allegation incident occurred on 07.09.2023 but FIR of the present case was lodged on 12.10.2023 i.e. after more than one month.

7. He further submits that however medical report of the injured suggests that she sustained incised wound and she in her statement recorded during investigation stated against the applicant but actually due to matrimonial dispute informant herself inflicted injury to her and after that applicant admitted her in the hospital and this fact is evident from her medical report.
8. He further submitted in the FIR it has wrongly been mentioned that on call police arrived at spot and police admitted the informant in the hospital.
He further submits that applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter applicant is in jail since 19.11.2023.

9. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of the informant and as per medical report she sustained incised wound and she had to remain in the hospital for considerable period of time and she in her statement recorded during investigation reiterated the version of the FIR, therefore, even if the applicant admitted the informant in the hospital being her husband, he should not be released on bail.
10. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

11. From the record, it reflects that applicant is husband of the informant and as per allegation on 07.09.2023 he inflicted knife injuries to her and from perusal of the injury report, it reflects that informant sustained knife injury and she had to remain in hospital for more than four days and injuries sustained to her appears to be dangerous to life.
12.

However, it appears that incident occurred on 07.09.2023 but FIR of the present case was lodged on 12.10.2023 i.e. after more than a month and record further suggests that informant had been discharged from the hospital on 13.09.2023 but it is a case of matrimonial dispute, therefore, if there is delay in lodging the FIR then merely on this ground entire prosecution case cannot be discarded considering the nature of allegation and injury sustained by the injured.

13. Further, however, from the medical report of the injured it reflects that applicant is the person who admitted her in the hospital and in the FIR informant stated that after receiving injury she called the police and thereafter police arrived and police admitted her in the hospital.

It appears that the version of the FIR is exaggerated one but merely on the basis of exaggeration at this stage entire story narrated by the victim in the FIR including the allegation that applicant is the person who caused knife injury to her cannot be completely disbelieved considering her medical report.

Further,
even if the applicant admitted her in the hospital then also the allegation leveled against him cannot be diluted.

Aamir vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157716058/
2 14.

Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.
15. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is rejected.

16. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
